codeReview.summary: The fix commit (f0e83c7) directly addresses the prior failure from fix-scrutiny-high-medium-quality by adding advisory locking around the full attached-registry read-modify-write critical section and by upgrading the registry concurrency test to real multi-threaded access. register_attached/unregister_attached now route through with_locked_registry, which acquires an exclusive flock before read, mutates under lock, writes under lock, and releases afterward. The prior commit’s remaining race (740cf3b: unique tmp files without read-modify-write locking) is therefore resolved.
